events.label: James Talarico August campaign event tax statement
Talarico campaign supports OBBBA middle-class tax provisions

slots.name: taxes on tips and overtime
slots.sentence: As for the ad’s claim that Talarico supports higher taxes on “tips, your overtime, even Social Security,” Talarico’s campaign said he specifically supports provisions of the OBBBA that cut taxes for the middle class, including taxes on tips, overtime pay and Social Security.
